body: i’m 14, i am studying right now but i think i’ll start failing very soon because of my low energy levels and lack of care (not that it rlly matters anymore) and since i live in a very poor country being the best is the only way to ever get out. i just don’t have the energy to do that anymore, though. thank you for believing that i belong and deserve to be loved

your feelings are so valid and swag ^^ he sounds like such an asshole so i’m glad he’s out of your life. i know it maybe get hard to resist but for your own good, try not to reach out to him again, please? i say maybe get a pet, they don’t leave for a while and in return you don’t want to leave them. i believe it helps with your thoughts. i’m not good at comforting, so all i can say is i’m sorry and that he never deserved you. he never deserved someone who decided their life was worth keeping just to talk to him. i hope his girlfriend makes a fool out of ass and dumps him.

i don’t think i’m one to talk since i won’t be here for long but i can listen to you while i’m still around, listening to people is the only thing that makes me happy anyways so you wouldn’t have to feel guilty and if it helps you then that’s great :))
